author: atilla1
quote: Straight up trash for 2 billion dollars. Bugs, 30 fps gap, no setting to turn off ray-tracing, trash story-telling, trash characters and the worst ever endings. Even GTA 5 story was some sort of good. Typical missions. Actually downgrade from RDR 2. If this game's budget was less than a billion I would rated it minimum 6. But yeah we got what we got. Still waiting for PC version just to play open world and not the story on 60+ fps without bugs. Shame on Rockstar for waiting too much on this trash. Also overpriced. WTF is 80$?!
